title: Strike
description: A sheet of paper and nothing else. It types a short letter to someone on its own, and when you type, every key bites the sheet with real typewriter character: uneven ink, a wandering baseline, ribbon texture, a margin bell and a carriage return.
intent: The typewriter without the machine: only the strike matters, so each letter is a ribbon-textured stamp with per-key wear, tilted pressure, heavier punctuation and the occasional ghost double strike, while the paper itself carries the carriage motion, the line feed and the page eject.
